# A04-S05: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

CONGRATULATIONS how cool is that [████]! I look forward to seeing the exhibition!
And it’s fantastic that Julina now has an eye! FINALLY. How exciting! So far Julina is a leader for me 😁
May I forward your mail to [████]?
[████]
Thanks for your mail – congratulations on the prize!
